name: formula-champion
description: WORKING champion weights for the deterministic formula policy (makeFormulaPolicy default: chain search + 1.5-ply lookahead + banking + fungal awareness). Strongest verified player.

provenance.method: CEM, RUN-SURVIVAL objective, two-stage eval, seeded from the prior (foresight) champion. Adds the FUNGAL package (decision #46): fungalClear (value per timed blight tile removed) + oppMatchHeal (penalty per HP handed to anySide match-heal relics like Vampiric Roots). World includes the Blight Warden (floors 1-2/5-7) with sim-mirrored fungal timers/explosions.

promoteCheck.note: fresh-seed tournament (ns fungal-final-2026-07-10, N=800/entry): incumbent 33.3%±1.7 vs challenger 40.0%±1.7 — +6.7pp (~4 SE)

provenance.notes: Deterministic evaluation pathway (CLAUDE.md pathway-dominance verdict). New weights this cycle: fungalClear/oppMatchHeal (genome 30→32). Absolute survival reads lower than the pre-Warden era — the world got harder (Blight Warden), not the policy weaker.
